title: Article. Two Ends of the Strategy Spectrum: The Consumer's Hierarchy of Preferences
summary:
And generally speaking, whenever you think of any business, there's sort of this trade-off
between volume and margin. And for many companies, they can charge a lower price and get more sales, or they could
charge a higher price and make a higher margin, but then their volume will drop off. And of course, this is because the more margin you take, the less sales you're going to
get, and so it could ultimately lead to fewer profits.

in the business allows a company to continue to work to improve their core value prop.
